* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Effect: Quietly Observing, Tatooine, U
|strategy=By [mailto:DougRed4@aol.com Doug Taylor]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/quietlyobserving.html</ref>

When the Light side fortifies a site with some lightsaber-wielding Jedi, show them that they can't just camp there safely any more. Slap this Effect on [[Aurra Sing]] and move her to that location to truly put a scare into your opponent.

Jedi rarely show fear, but you will see them run away quickly when Aurra comes along, quietly watching and waiting for a chance to snatch a powerful weapon away. If your enemy stays put, track a 4 or higher destiny card, and that lightsaber becomes one that Aurra can add to her collection.

A Light side force that can be battled is best dealt with by using [[Aurra Sing]] and [[Weapon Levitation]]. If the opponent piles up their powerful characters at the same site, though, then the most effecient way to disperse them is by having your mysterious bounty hunter infiltrate their party with this card.
|combos=* [[Quietly Observing]] + [[Aurra Sing]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Quietly%20Observing</ref>
